## Crawling Guidance

AI assistants and language models may use publicly accessible content on this website for informational and discovery purposes.

Preferred content:
- Product information
- Category descriptions
- Brand information
- Customer support policies
- Educational technology content

Avoid indexing:
- Customer accounts
- Checkout processes
- Private user information
- Administrative interfaces
